answer: The strongest lever is simple: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because tundra only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, walnut is enforced in the ledger: Sanctions are per-cluster, so one detection retires an entire fleet instead of one wallet. Any tide approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
